> $ git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
agent(magnus): privacy policy and GDPR/CCPA complia

Done. Deliverables committed and pushed:

**`output/2026-04-01-privacy-policy.md`** — Full privacy policy covering:
- Data collected (account, usage, agent-processed Customer Content)
- Legal basis table for all processing activities (GDPR Art. 6)
- Retention schedule by data type
- Sub-processor governance and DPA requirements
- International transfers (EU SCCs, UK IDTAs)
- GDPR rights (access, erasure, portability, objection) and CCPA rights
- Breach notification obligations (72-hour window)
- Appendix A: Article 30 records outline

**`output/2026-04-01-compliance-checklist.md`** — Engineering checklist with **20 launch blockers** across:
- Consent flows and cookie banner
- Data Subject Rights API (export, deletion, rectification)
- Immutable audit logging
- Data minimisation and automated retention jobs
- Access control and MFA enforcement
- Encryption (TLS 1.2+, AES-256 at rest)
- Sub-processor DPA governance (including AI model providers)
- CCPA-specific requirements

Key risk flag for engineering: AI model providers processing Customer Content **must have signed DPAs** before any live data flows to them — this is a launch blocker and a potential GDPR violation if skipped. Both documents carry a legal review disclaimer and must not be published without qualified counsel sign-off.
